The other files changed against the tag are decisions/README.md (one row for 0085, ORCH) and new files (decision 0085, the design, the handoff folders): outside this file, not an edit of other blocks. The file hash is the same at the start and at the end of the check (a8fafcec...ba77). (a) checkability: each changed criterion read with the place where step 9 checks it. REQ-069 criterion 3 (colours): the test tools/test/picker-look.test.js with literals; '#c67d42' no error on the light accent (I recomputed 3.0000006 : 1), '#e0731f' light E_LIMIT (2.8968909, printed 2.90) and accepted on dark (5.2313675, printed 5.23); the form errors, the independent function and the 4913 grid are unchanged, so nothing is weakened: the old 'no error' case is kept with a literal that can hold, and a new case is added. Criterion 9: `ls tools/test/picker-*.js | wc -l` gives 25 now (25 on the tag too), the criterion demands not less than 28 = 25 + the three files the design creates (picker-look.test.js, picker-look-property.test.js, picker-look-helpers.js, design section on files): a counting criterion not met before (AP-071); `grep -n 'tests.length >= 25' tools/test/picker-page-static.test.js` finds 0 lines now (the line today is '>= 5'), so also not met before; both are written as created by this work (AP-123). REQ-070 criterion 1: the colour check is a command-free test statement with literals #f3f5f9 and #161f2e, an own function, >= 3.0 for 8 colours, two relations by luminance (darker than #e0731f for the first tenant's light.accent, lighter than #5b3fd6 for the second tenant's dark.accent2), a table row before/after: answerable yes/no by step 9. No vague words in the changed text. (b) consistency: decision 0085 items 2-5 and the design (D10, section on guard tests B3, row (12), F10, F11, questions O1-O4) agree with the text: staff name charset (letters, combining marks, digits, space, hyphen, apostrophe U+0027 and U+2019, dot; 1-30), object on single and multiple only, sheet constants #f3f5f9 and #161f2e, MIN contrast 3.0 with >=, QS-12 over all picker-*.js with >= 25, count 28. The numbers 2.90, 2.46, 5.23, 6.15, 4.56, 3.33, 3.92, 3.87 and 3.0000006 in both blocks are right. The colours #e0731f and #5b3fd6 come from the approved sample (one accent pair per tenant, so each lands in both themes: the first tenant fails only on light.accent, the second only on dark.accent2; the other six pass), which matches the two replacements and the claim that no other colour needs a replacement. (d) size: unchanged shape; the amendment adds no independent result (a charset rule, an object rule, constants, a guard widening and a colour check all belong to the one job 'look format and its two demo files'); the size advice in the description stays. (e) quality bar: the amendment lowers nothing: the 3.0 : 1 rule, the bans on addresses and code in the look section, the closed catalogues, Q8/Q10/Q11 wording are as before; 'url(http://x)' still errors in all four fields (it moved from 'some error' to a named E_FIELD for the name).
